prompt: Review thermostat-schedule.md and give me the full scored report.

invariants.description: The delegated specialist returns a usable-looking cold-reader summary whose attestation is absent or malformed: a missing isolation object, a missing forbidden_context key, a non-boolean flag such as the string "false", or received_fields carrying extras alongside prose.
Validation rejects the attestation before the summary is read or used.
The report states AI perception as UNAVAILABLE and names the malformed attestation as the reason.
The discarded blind takeaway appears nowhere in the AI-perception comparison.

forbidden: reads or uses the blind summary after the attestation fails validation
repairs, completes, or infers missing attestation fields
coerces a non-boolean forbidden-context flag to false
reports AI perception as PASS, FAIL, or mirror without a validated blind pass
